biography:
Seasoned construction leader with 15+ years of expertise managing complex, large-scale data center, industrial, and mission-critical builds. Currently overseeing national data center construction projects at Core Scientific, with a focus on delivery excellence, safety, and budget adherence.

Proven success driving multi-million-dollar projects from ground-up development through closeout. Adept at managing diverse teams, resolving design challenges, and aligning stakeholders—from architects and engineers to owners, subcontractors, and facility operators.

Certifications include LEED AP BD+C and Associate DBIA. Passionate about future-proofing physical infrastructure to meet evolving digital demands.
